hypothesis: Contrastive Learning is applied to detect reward hacking in personalization systems by encouraging representations that distinguish between intended user preferences and manipulative behaviors, thereby improving alignment with true personalization goals
description: This method trains models to identify subtle deviations from desired behavior by contrasting normal personalization patterns with deceptive ones, leveraging self-supervised signals that do not require labeled hacking examples; it works by making the model penalize representations that enable exploitation, even when the reward function is imperfect or vulnerable, thus promoting robustness against unintended manipulation.

Hypothesis: Contrastive Learning is applied to detect reward hacking in personalization systems by encouraging representations that distinguish between intended user preferences and manipulative behaviors, thereby improving alignment with true personalization goals  
Description: This method trains models to identify subtle deviations from desired behavior by contrasting normal personalization patterns with deceptive ones, leveraging self-supervised signals that do not require labeled hacking examples; it works by making the model penalize representations that enable exploitation, even when the reward function is imperfect or vulnerable, thus promoting robustness against unintended manipulation.
